header.title: How to Troubleshoot a Dishwasher Door Latch
header.description: This guide provides step-by-step instructions on how to diagnose and fix common issues with your dishwasher door latch. Learn to test, inspect, lubricate, and check the strike plate to restore proper latch function.

steps.description: Test the dishwasher door switch by turning off the water supply and depressing the switch to check for electrical activity.
actions: TURN OFF THE WATER supply
find the switch location by looking at the type of latch used
look for the switch inside an opening at the top of the door opening
depress the switch with an object of similar size and shape
check if the dishwasher comes on

steps.description: Inspect the dishwasher door latch for any obstructions like food particles or debris.
actions: Closely inspect the latch
Clean out any lodged debris
Test the dishwasher after cleaning

steps.description: Lubricate the latch mechanism to ensure smooth movement and remove any accumulated dirt or obstructions.
actions: Spray the latch area with bolt loosener.
Move the latch back and forth with a rag or fingers.
Spray the latch area with penetrating lubricant.
Move the latch back and forth with a rag or fingers.

steps.description: Inspect the dishwasher strike plate for alignment issues and readjust or replace it if necessary.
actions: Locate the strike plate on the dishwasher.
Inspect the strike plate for abnormalities (bent, loose, or out of alignment).
Readjust the strike plate to its original shape and location within the door frame opening.
Straighten the strike plate with proper tools if bent.
Remove and reinstall the strike plate if straightening is not possible.
Replace the strike plate if defective.
Operate the door closed while watching the latch hit the plate to adjust as needed.
Tighten the strike plate into place.
